intro_text: Grundstock is three days of music, workshops and togetherness in the countryside near Vilswörth, organised by the non-profit association Neues Brett from Regensburg. No commerce, no sponsor walls. Everything here exists because people care. And since everyone pitches in, the whole thing works like a scout camp: build together, celebrate together, clean up together!
lineup_text: This year old friends meet fresh acts: hip-hop, indie, Latin, DnB, rock, disco and techno. The full lineup lands here as soon as it's set.

verein_intro: Grundstock is organised by Neues Brett e.V., a registered non-profit from Regensburg. Nobody earns anything here. Every euro flows back into the festival and future projects.
verein_values_text: A festival from friends for friends. Built, cooked and mixed by ourselves! It only works because everyone pitches in. That feeling of creating something together is the core of it all.
verein_mitmachen_text: The easiest way: join us at the festival! Want more responsibility? Become a Mittelgschaftler. You take an eight-hour shift and get half the ticket price back.
verein_spenden_text: Want to support the association without attending? We're happy about donations via bank transfer:
verein_spenden_receipt: For a donation receipt (from €100) simply send us an email to {email}.
verein_kontakt_text: Questions, ideas, want to join? Write us:
anreise_intro: The festival takes place in Vilswörth near Rieden, in the countryside west of Regensburg. There are four ways to reach us. The most relaxed one is the shuttle.
anreise_shuttle_text: Take our festival shuttle from {stop} straight to the festival grounds. A ticket costs €{price} and is available in the same shop as the festival tickets.
anreise_oepnv_text: There is a direct connection to the festival grounds. For example by train to Amberg and from there with bus lines {lines} to the {stop} stop.
anreise_rad_text: You're very welcome to ride straight onto the grounds. Please use the access road {road}.
anreise_rad_tour_text: On Thursday morning we ride from Regensburg to the festival together, with a Soundboks in the trailer and a snack taxi! We'll happily carry your luggage to the grounds for you. All the details are in the WhatsApp group.
anreise_auto_text: Public parking is available at the {place}. Spaces are limited, so please carpool!
anreise_auto_overflow: If all the spaces at the fire station are taken, please move to the adjacent streets.
anreise_auto_nodrive: There is no vehicle access to the festival grounds!
anreise_auto_onward: From Vilshofen, take bus lines {lines} to the {stop} stop. We're also planning a private shuttle between the car parks and the grounds, probably twice a day. Times will be posted in the WhatsApp group.
anreise_warning_title: Important: no footpath to the grounds
anreise_warning_text: There is no footpath to the festival grounds from Vilshofen or from the car parks. Walking along the main road is not permitted, and we were not granted any other pedestrian access. So please plan firmly with the bus or the shuttle!
abreise_text: All four options work in reverse too. Just check the relevant timetables.
abreise_night_text: If you want to leave the grounds on foot at night, outside service hours, you can take the emergency route across the Vils towards {route}.
abreise_abbau_text: We start taking everything down on Sunday morning and every helping hand is very welcome! If you have the time and the energy, please stick around. Whoever works hard and lasts long enough might even make it to the legendary afterparty.
anreise_camping_text: Everyone sleeps in tents right on the grounds. So pack your tent, sleeping bag and mat! More details to follow.
infos_intro: Answers to the most common questions about the festival. The list grows as new questions come in.
workshops_title: Try things, hang out, get inspired
workshops_text: Mornings and daytimes are full of workshops of all kinds. This year with a new workshop tent, new artists and the people you already love. Just drop by and join in!
inclusive_food_text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included in your ticket. Really good vegan food for everyone, as much as you want!
inclusive_snack_text: Yours for a few Gulden on top, so nobody dances hungry at night!
inclusive_drinks_text: Drinks at fair prices, from soda to espresso martini. You really don't need much money here.
inclusive_dishes_text: For the environment's sake there's no disposable tableware again this year. So pack a deep plate, a fork and a spoon! Washing up happens at the newly built washing stations. It's going to be delicious!
helfen_title: The festival that only works with you
helfen_text: Grundstock is a family affair and it only works if everyone pitches in. That's why everyone takes exactly one shift: kitchen, bar, cleanup or whatever suits you.
helfen_shift_text: One shift per person is mandatory. In the Helfertool you simply pick whatever you feel like doing.
helfen_mittel_text: Want to take on more responsibility? As a Mittelgschaftler you take an 8-hour shift and pay only half the ticket price!
mittel_dialog_text: Mittelgschaftler are the people who take on a bit more responsibility at Grundstock. You work one 8-hour shift and pay only half the ticket price!
mittel_dialog_invite: That's exactly what our festival is built on: people who want to get involved and pitch in. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! Just send us a short email at {email}.
helfen_donate_text: You can also support the association with a donation: {accountHolder}, IBAN {iban}. For a donation receipt (from €100) write to {email}.
location_text: The festival takes place on a meadow near Vilswörth (municipality of Rieden), in the middle of the Upper Palatinate countryside.
shuttle_text: No car? No problem! Our shuttle buses take you there and back. Shuttle tickets are available in the same shop as the festival tickets.
story_text: What started as a small gathering of friends has grown into a festival full of music, art and community. The idea is still the same: homemade, honest and with heart. By people from Regensburg, for everyone who wants to belong.
recap_consent: Playing loads the video from YouTube. Data may be transferred to Google.
tickets_text: Food is included and drinks are cheap. All you need is your ticket and a good mood! Mittelgschaftler even pay only half.

awareness_text: Grundstock should be a place where everyone feels comfortable, safe and welcome. No matter who you are or who you love. There is no room for discrimination or abusive behaviour here. And if you ever feel uncomfortable, our awareness team is there for you.
faq_q1: Do I really have to take a shift?
faq_a1: Yes, exactly one! Grundstock only works if everyone pitches in. You pick what suits you in the Helfertool: kitchen, bar, cleanup and more.
faq_a2: Entry for all festival days and three meals a day (vegan and really good). New this year: a midnight meal for a few Gulden (our festival currency) on top! Drinks are extra, but cheap.
faq_a3: By shuttle from Regensburg (Thursday and Friday), by car or carpool. All times are in the Getting there section.
faq_a4: 18+ only, and don't forget your ID! There is one exception: minors accompanied by their parents may join the festival. The responsibility then lies with the parents.
faq_a5: Anyone who takes a longer shift (8 hours) and a bit more responsibility pays only half the ticket price. Anyone can apply.
footer_credit: Grundstock is a project by Neues Brett e.V., a registered non-profit.
